g.text: The harness owns decisions; execution crosses a boundary
Keep evidence contracts and lifecycle rules stable while input tools and approved agent hosts change.
Explicit CLI operations; one persistent security case.
Execution and change authority live here.
Read-only view reads the case; it cannot authorize a change.
Rollout and closure are operator attestations
PROPOSED PRODUCTION: authenticated identity / isolated workers / credential + egress broker / trusted evidence ingestion
A task packet is a scope and evidence contract. It is not credentials or an isolation boundary.
Local actor labels provide attribution, not authenticated RBAC. Reference execution is not network/container isolation. No live Cloud API connector.
